application_review: A basis formed from actual direct integer complements preserves every already adapted submodule below the first factor. Finite antitone flags of split submodules of finite free modules over a PID have one actual finite basis simultaneously generating every layer by its columns lying in that layer. Restricting an actual complement to the first layer supplies the recursive split, not independent unrelated complement choices.

Applied to the actual integer intersections of any finite integer module in a real vector space, primitive real-subspace quotients supply all actual splits. For a genuine full integer lattice and actual spanning intersections, one integer basis of exactly the real dimension and its same-column real basis simultaneously generate every specified layer.

Real extension of actual rational subspaces in a proved full rational form preserves intersections, by the existing compatible coordinate square and the proved finite rational coordinate intersection theorem. Actual original lattice-rational subspaces are closed under intersections. The genuine original center is lattice-rational, and its actual integer intersections with all original Lie lower-central layers real-span the corresponding central layers by actual positive-power denominator clearing.

One chosen genuine original central integer lattice basis and its identical-column real basis simultaneously generate all original lower-central intersections for every natural layer index. A finite flag through the actual group nilpotency class includes the terminal layer and supplies all later layers by antitonicity; zero class and zero-dimensional cases are included.

The same adapted central basis has exact original Gamma membership if and only if integer real coordinates, genuine global central exponential coordinates, integer lattice columns, original rational log-span columns, and an exact original ordered exponential product formula. Actual original group lower-central membership is equivalent to zero coordinates in every basis direction outside the layer, using the proved exact original group/Lie layer equality.

The adapted central exponential coordinate map into the original group is smooth. Its actual globally smooth coordinate recovery function uses the original global logarithm and the proved continuous linear center retraction. Two-sided recovery on all genuine original central elements is proved.

The finite-flag theorem is proved by induction on the number of layers. At each step the first original layer A and its actual complement Q form a product equivalence; the recursively adapted basis of A and the basis of Q are mapped through that equivalence. For every T below A, mapping the actual integer span in A proves that T is generated by the final basis vectors in T. The upper span inclusion follows from actual T membership. No compatibility is inferred merely from independent complements.

The recursive complements are the comaps of actual original complements to A. The modular-lattice IsCompl restriction lemma applies because antitonicity puts every later layer below A. Finite generation and freeness of submodules come from the finite free PID module. Reindexing the finite sum of basis indices proves the same layer spans. No total order on these finite indices, consecutive block property, adapted full-group basis, or paper horizontal norm identification is inferred.

Integer subspace flags are actual preimages under the original lattice inclusion, and the real-space torsion-free structure proves the original finite integer module free. The previous actual primitive-quotient/complement theorem discharges each split premise. For a full lattice, the proved integer rank equals the real dimension, so the final finite integer basis has exactly that dimension.

The rational intersection theorem transports actual real spans through an injective real coordinate equivalence and the existing identical-column rational basis. Actual injective map preservation of intersections and the proved rational-coordinate span intersection theorem discharge the equality. Ambient submodule intersections in span expressions are explicitly typed before coercion to sets.

Center lattice rationality follows from the actual original central Gamma intersection logarithms real-spanning the actual center and lying in the original rational log span. Rational intersection closure and actual positive-power clearing yield original exponential vectors spanning center intersect layer. The image under the actual center inclusion is proved exactly that set, and injectivity proves the actual central integer-layer span. No additive lattice of full nonabelian Log Gamma is assumed.

The all-natural-index central flag basis uses a finite flag of length nilpotencyClass(G)+1. At and after the actual nilpotency class the true Lie layers are bottom, by the registered original group nilpotency theorem and antitonicity. The subtype inclusion has zero kernel. Thus the same selected basis handles every later layer, including nilpotency class zero.

The real basis is made from that exact selected integer basis by ofZLatticeBasis. Chosen integer coordinates of actual lattice vectors equal their real coordinates, and the converse reconstructs the original vector by a finite integer sum. The central exponential homeomorphism is the true original one; original Gamma membership and ordered products are proved for this new basis, with no equality asserted to the earlier arbitrary center basis.

Layer membership uses the actual basis representation support theorem. Substituting the actual simultaneous layer-span identity gives zero coefficients outside the layer. The group result invokes the proved exact original algebraic group lower-central series equality, the actual logarithm membership theorem and the actual exponential/logarithm inverse.

The smooth recovery proof follows the prior retained arbitrary-center recovery argument with this new actual basis, and is checked anew. The continuous linear retraction is identity on the actual center; logarithm cancels the original exponential; the actual basis coordinate equivalence cancels synthesis. Smoothness uses the original smooth logarithm and actual continuous linear maps. The forward map is exactly the proved ordered exponential product in the new basis.
